kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نخضوضب (form XII)
# نَخْضَوْضِبُ (naḵḍawḍibu) /nax.dˤaw.dˤi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
# نَخْضَوْضِبَ (naḵḍawḍiba) /nax.dˤaw.dˤi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
# نَخْضَوْضِبْ (naḵḍawḍib) /nax.dˤaw.dˤib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
